== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (25 July 2024, [[:File:V23-L-passagetothealderaansystem-PC-E1.png|V23-L-passagetothealderaansystem-PC-E1.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (page 5). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
